overview: This House resolution assigns members of the House to standing committees, the permanent panels where bills are first reviewed. It places Representative Kiley of California on the Transportation and Infrastructure, Judiciary, and Education and Workforce committees, each at a specified seniority rank. It also places Representative Fuller on the Small Business and Transportation and Infrastructure committees. Resolutions like this are a routine way to fill committee seats when members join or change assignments. The House agreed to it on April 15, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that fills committee seats so the House can carry out its work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to, since this is an internal housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
